prior_construction.title: Many collinear k-tuples with no k+1 collinear points

implementation.source_binding: The complete module used for these observations is published alongside this record; the publication binds each complete file to its Git blob.
implementation.integer_arithmetic: BigInt for coordinates, primitive coefficients and point-line equalities
implementation.ordering: numeric lexicographic point coordinates and canonical primitive line coefficients
implementation.point_and_line_ids: zero-based IDs assigned by the original compiled input and retained in subset views

evidence_scope.input_set_semantics: Duplicate geometric points are deduplicated; every geometric line is counted once.
evidence_scope.admissibility: P_k means no line contains more than k of the listed distinct points.
evidence_scope.finite_result: The 40-point subset has P_4 and exactly 20 four-point lines, establishing f_4(40) >= 20.
evidence_scope.subset_scope: A subset view can only retain point IDs from its parent. Complete incidence of the listed points does not authenticate absent parent records.
evidence_scope.certificate_scope: Unique primitive lines, valid point incidences and complete unordered-pair accounting certify the listed finite geometry. Published Git blob identities independently bind source and data.
evidence_scope.timings: Single observations in connected V8, not a comparative or statistical benchmark.
